mechanism: CRiGaussProperty extends CRiBuffDbl; on any array change ToArray() then CAlglib::SampleMoments yields sliding-window mean, variance→StdDev, skewness, kurtosis over period BPeriod. ENUM_GAUSS_PROPERTY selects which moment to plot as a continuous sensor.
data_needed: Price series (Close or applied price); ring max total = BPeriod; AlgLib SampleMoments.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT5 chart indicator; user period (default 13); any symbol/TF
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an O(window)-refreshable higher-moment volatility/shape sensor (skew/kurtosis) as a sliding feature, not just variance.
quote: Let's develop the indicator calculating the main Gaussian distribution parameters: mean value (Mean); standard deviation (StdDev); bell-shaped distribution asymmetry (Skewness); Kurtosis.

mechanism: CRiMaxMin stores per-bar how many prior elements are below (max-chain) or above (min-chain). Query MaxIndex/MinIndex by jumping c_max = c_max - ext - 1, skipping dominated bars; optional sub-period limit. Yields sliding High/Low channel without full O(n) scan each step.
data_needed: Streaming High/Low (or any series) into ring of size N; optional max_period ≤ N.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Price bars High/Low channel indicator; Stochastic built on same primitives; multi-symbol M1–MN1 load test (EURUSD,GBPUSD,USDCHF,USDJPY)
why_new_for_mis: Fast sliding-range extrema are a core volatility/regime envelope sensor MIS can run densely across symbols/TFs without ArrayMaximum cost.
quote: Due to to the previously calculated indices, we avoided comparison with four intermediate bars, which are certainly below the current one.

mechanism: CRiBuffDbl FIFO with OnAddValue/OnRemoveValue/OnChangeValue/OnChangeArray hooks; derived CRiSMA (sum±), CRiEMA (α=2/(1+N)), CRiMACD (fast/slow EMA delta + SMA signal), CRiStoch ((C−min)/(max−min)·100 then SMA %K/%D). ChangeValue updates forming bar without rebuild.
data_needed: Streaming closes (and H/L for Stochastic); periods for SMA/EMA/MACD/Stoch.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: SMA/EMA/MACD/Stoch demos vs standard indicators; scanner stress 4 symbols × 21 TFs
why_new_for_mis: Event-driven sliding-window primitive layer lets MIS compose sequence sensors (MACD/Stoch/moments) with fixed memory and O(1) updates—infra for multi-instrument sensing panels.
quote: The ring buffer algorithm solves the efficient calculation issue providing a sliding window to the calculation block so that its internal calculations remain simple and as efficient as possible.

mechanism: On Universal ZigZag peaks, require ≥5 points; buy when v3≪v1, v4≫v1, v4≪v2 (K1/K2 gaps), last segment crosses line 1–3 (point 5), and h2−h4>K3·h2 so lines 1–3 and 2–4 meet to the right. Target time = TwoLinesCrossX(1–3,2–4); target price = y3 on line 1–4 at that bar. Arrows+dots; optional tick-volume drop and post-trendline-break filters from Wolfe tips.
data_needed: ZigZag peaks (HighLow/Close/RSI/MA source); K1,K2,K3; OHLC or indicator series; optional tick volume.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 EA full-history test; any TF with ZigZag; Src_HighLow/Close/RSI/MA
why_new_for_mis: Codifies Wolfe wedge as an automated reversal/change detector with joint price-and-time target—MIS can treat point-5 cross as a regime-flip event with a measurable horizon.
quote: Point 6 at the intersection of lines 1—3 and 2—4 determines target reaching time. The target value (point 7) is defined as the intersection of line 1—4 and the vertical line drawn through point 6.

mechanism: Replay signal CSV trades on subscriber M1 quotes. Entry quality K(In)=1/(1+MAE/Result); exit quality K(Out)=Result/MFE; K(Deal)=K(In)+K(Out) (perfect=2). Comfort K(Comfort)=(ProfitBars−LossBars)/TotalBars from M1 bars fully above/below open (straddle bars=0). Also quotes-match % within slippage. Distributions of K(Deal) and K(Comfort) score signal providers.
data_needed: Signal trade history CSV (open/close time, symbol, side, prices); broker M1 OHLC; slippage tolerance (e.g. 50 pts 5-digit).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: MT4 Signals Service top-5 + free signals; multi-symbol from Distribution tab; analysis on M1
why_new_for_mis: Turns trade path MAE/MFE and time-in-profit into quantitative execution-quality sensors MIS can use to score strategies/signals beyond PnL and drawdown.
quote: Entry quality K(In)= 1/(1 + МАE/Result) Exit quality K(Out)= Result/MFE

mechanism: Williams-style 5-bar fractal peaks/troughs: start at highest (resistance) or lowest (support) fractal in window; second point = next lower/higher fractal; speedr=(y2−y1)/(x2−x1); project ResistanceBuffer[w]=high[r1]+speedr*(w−r1). Invalidate on break beyond Pips_ or MaxBars length, then search anew. Rising/falling/horizontal incline maps to uptrend/downtrend/channel roles.
data_needed: OHLC High/Low; fractal neighbor checks; Pips_ breakout tolerance; MaxBars max length.
why_new_for_mis: Automated fractal-anchored slanted S/R with breakout reset is a live regime corridor sensor (trend vs channel) for MIS.
quote: The resistance line is the price movement line over a certain period of time, above which the price does not rise.

mechanism: Copy High/Low/Time from higher Period_TF; for each chart bar map to prior HTF bar via ArrayBsearch; hl=h−l; place levels h−hl·k_fibo and l+hl·k_fibo for coefficients (0.5 median + K_Fibo_1..3). Prior day (or HTF bar) extremes become next-session horizontal S/R grid.
data_needed: Higher-TF High/Low/Time; K_Fibo coefficients; chart TF bars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Resistance_Support_H; HTF selectable (e.g. D1 levels on lower TF); bounce examples on chart
why_new_for_mis: Projects prior HTF range Fibonacci grid as a multi-level horizontal regime map MIS can refresh each HTF bar.
quote: we can treat any daily High as a resistance level, and Low as a support level.

mechanism: iHorizontalFormation on ZigZag: require prior move l1≥K1·base (base=first pattern segment); shape PatternTapered/Rectangular/Expanding via consecutive segment sizes vs K2·base; slope InclineAlong/Horizontally/Against via segment midpoints vs K3·base; N tops/bottoms. Complete Immediately or on OneLastVertex/TwoLastVertices breakout; target FromVertexToVertex / OneVertex / TwoVertices (TwoLinesCrossY).
data_needed: Universal ZigZag peaks; K1,K2,K3,N; CompletionType; TargetType.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: iHorizontalFormation + iTester; any TF with ZigZag; continuation after impulse
why_new_for_mis: Unifies Flag-like rectangle and contracting/expanding triangles as post-impulse consolidation regime states with explicit breakout completion—MIS change/continuation sensor.
quote: To form a horizontal pattern, the price should make a noticeable vertical movement, and then form at least two tops at approximately the same price level and two bottoms

mechanism: iFlag: long bar if high−low>ATR(ATRPeriod)·K1 sets expected direction by candle color; then require ≥MinCount bars with Overlapping=min(H)−max(L) ≥ MinOverlapping·PreSize. PatternParameters → AverSize, AverBias, AverSizeDif classify FormTapered/Rectangular/Expanding and InclineAlong/Horizontal/Against; enter Along/Against finishing bar; target = pole height.
data_needed: OHLC; iATR; K1, MinOverlapping, MinCount; form/incline toggles and K coeffs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: iFlag indicator; chart TF of attachment; ATR-relative (TF-robust)
why_new_for_mis: Bar-overlap geometry after an ATR impulse detects Flag/Pennant/Wedge consolidation without ZigZag—orthogonal regime sensor for MIS.
quote: The overlap of two bars must exceed a threshold value… Overlapping=MathMin(high[i],high[i-1])-MathMax(low[i],low[i-1]).

mechanism: Measure horizontal (trend vs OX), vertical (trend vs OY), and turning (between two trends) angles via arctan(Δprice/Δbars) with scale-invariant code (Angles_3_points, ChartAngles, DegreeAngles_Zero). Andrews median rebuilt as angle bisector; if vertical Andrews angle > horizontal → rising regime, else falling. Peak/trough sequences of red/blue Andrews angles give buy/sell/close signals; dual-TF Elder-style correction. Turning angles grow with TF (M1≈48°, M5≈104°, …) like spectral components.
data_needed: ZigZag or regression line over N bars; three points for manual angles; dual bar counts for multi-TF.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD examples M1–D1; ChartAngles/DegreeAnglesZero on M1–H4 preferred; MT4
why_new_for_mis: Adds vertical and turning angles plus bisector Andrews angles as explicit trend/flat/reversal regime features beyond Gann fans—TF-dependent turning angle is a multi-scale regime sensor.
quote: If the horizontal Andrews' angle (the red line color) is greater than the vertical Andrews' angle, it is a sign of a falling trend. If the vertical Andrews' angle (the blue line color) is greater than the horizontal Andrews' angle, it is a sign of a rising trend.

mechanism: CSignal/CSignals: each signal emits CMD_VOID(-1)/NEUTRAL(0)/LONG(1)/SHORT(2) for entry and/or exit. Entry: all non-neutral must agree or result VOID; one VOID vetoes all. Exit: signals accumulate independently (VOID closes all). Phases Refresh→Calculate→Long/ShortCondition→Update; per-signal indicator instances enable multi-symbol/TF. Examples: bar-alternate, MA vs close, Heiken Ashi body, HA∧MA.
data_needed: Per-signal indicators (MA, custom HA, etc.); symbol manager; entry/exit flags; optional invert/new_signal gate.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: MT4+MT5 cross-platform; chart symbol/TF; MA and Heiken Ashi examples
why_new_for_mis: Discrete VOID/NEUTRAL/LONG/SHORT consensus is a clean multi-sensor fusion layer MIS can use to combine heterogeneous regime detectors with hard veto semantics.
quote: for an entry signal to result to the EA executing a trade, that signal and all the other entry signals should agree to the same direction (all long or all short).
